record.field: Analyzes invoice using structured data extracted by LLM from OCR. Consolidates: partner matching (VAT/name), duplicate check, product matching (supplier codes), and historical patterns. The LLM must first parse the OCR text and extract structured fields, then pass them to this tool.

Updates invoice by creating lines and updating header with approved analysis data. Consolidates: batch line creation, header updates (partner, ref, date), and validation. Only call after user approves the analysis.
